label: FP-RSP-PREROUND-CUT
title: Cut FP response-ready and iterative pre-round setup paths
model_selection: spawn_agent 省略 model；用户已确认平台默认通道为 gpt-5.6-luna[max]

review.model_selection: spawn_agent 省略 model；用户已确认平台默认通道为 gpt-5.6-luna[max]
review.scope: 只读审查 T-049 top-N 到 lcvex_fp_exec/lcvex_fp_scalar 的映射、held-response 握手和 iterative latency 风险

scope: 修复 T-049 full-FP setup top 两个路径族：`exmem_valid~DUPLICATE -> g_fp_simd_enabled.fp_exec|rsp_r.gpr_data[6]`（-1.406 ns/27L）与 `g_iter.ap_pre.pa.exp2 -> g_iter.pp_pre.sig`（约 -1.392 ns）。限定在 FP transaction wrapper/scalar 内做最小寄存器控制解耦或切级，保持 held response、kill、单在途、slot/iterative latency 与 FP/NEON 架构语义；不得修改 core 或 SDC。

l0: systemd-run --user --scope -p MemoryMax=16G -p MemorySwapMax=0 -- make VERILATOR_JOBS=1 compile
l1: FP exec held-response/ready/kill 定向测试验证 rsp_valid 保持、payload 稳定、单次消费与 reset/kill 值
FP scalar/NEON P7-1/3/4/5 SV 与 Cocotb 受影响回归通过
任何 iterative stage/latency 变化都更新并验证 FDIV/FSQRT 与 slot 响应周期
l2: p7-1 scalar FP、p7-3 NEON FP、p7-4/p7-5 sequence 中受影响锁步通过

acceptance: 源码结构上切断 response ready/clear 对完整 rsp_r payload 的长控制路径，并进一步打断或实质缩短 ap_pre->pp_pre 组合路径；rsp_valid 下 payload 必须稳定到 ready，握手仅消费一次，kill/reset 优先级不变，空闲时 payload 无架构意义但 reset/kill 值明确；FPCR/FPSR/FCMP/raw-bit、FDIV/FSQRT、conversion GPR result、NEON lane 与顺序 commit 全部保持。compile、定向 L1 和可运行 L2 通过，不用 false_path/关闭断言/修改参考结果。实际物理改善由后续 FP-P5 rerun 确认。
known_limits: T-051 owns rtl/lcvex_core.sv and core/IRQ tests; T-052 may read but must not modify core or T-051 worktree
若确认 response top 必须修改 core/exmem_can_adv/fp_rsp_ready，必须阻断并请求重新划分写集，不能越权
不得运行 Quartus、修改 QSF/SDC/QEMU fork、assembler/SOF 或远端 T-049 probe
本地重型 Verilator 与 T-051 不得同时占用超过 50% 资源；全部命令 cgroup <16 GiB、VERILATOR_JOBS=1

integrator_review.notes: Final code review found no blockers. Integrator reran compile, FP exec response/kill/latency directed TB, P7-4 sequence 142/142 and P7-3 NEON FP 48/48 on merge_sha; all passed. Physical STA remains a separate follow-up.

next: 与 T-051 串行集成后重跑 FP-P5；若 setup 全绿才进入 assembler/SOF

blockers: g_iter.it_divider does not connect iter_kill/iter_pause, so wrapper kill can expose a stale divider result to an immediately reissued FDIV
ap_pre cut must split after aligned extended operands and before effective add/sub/cancellation, carrying all special/format/round metadata
TX_DONE ready may leave invalid payload unchanged only if reset/kill still clear it and rsp_valid-held payload stability/single-consume are tested

final_review.notes: Response invalid-payload retention, ADD/SUB alignment split, IT_ALIGN reset/kill and divider cancellation reviewed; physical STA remains pending.
